status: UNSUPPORTED / FABRICATED - Lead does not appear anywhere in this document. Table 1 (pages 9-12) has only TDS, SO4, Ba, Sr columns; no lead column, no narrative mention, no reference. Prior claim of 'Lead 8.3 µg/L max detected 2012-2023' attributed to this document is not supported by any content in it.

UNSUPPORTED / FABRICATED - Arsenic is mentioned only qualitatively (twice, pages 3-4) as one of several constituents historically found in FMC facility groundwater per RWQCB 1998 and Parsons 2009/2013, and as one of the analytes in the 2014 Evaluation's initial screening. It was NOT carried into the detailed statistical analysis (only TDS, sulfate, barium, strontium were, per pages 3-4) and has no numeric concentration, MCL, or target level stated anywhere. Prior claim of 'Arsenic 6.6 µg/L max detected 2012-2023' attributed to this document is not supported by any content in it.

UNSUPPORTED / FABRICATED - No 'sitewide mean ~210 µg/L' figure for barium appears anywhere in this document.
